title: 第13章 睚眦必报第14章 天资
content_zh:
长卿看着三人服下了丹药，心中不由感叹。
“天道好轮回。”
这丹药是长卿亲眼看着柳露炼出来的毒丹。
而且炼制的时候，柳露使用了一枚深紫色的御灵，那御灵散发着恐怖的气息，柳露从中提炼出几滴精华，全都投入到了丹炉中。
长卿窍穴中的那玫骨刺灵是下品黄灵，是乳白色的。前世他也见过玫瑰使用淡蓝色的玄灵。
柳露使用的这枚御灵却是深紫色的，他不确定这是什么级别的御灵，不是地灵就是天灵。
这毒性和威力可想而知。
看着几人服下丹药，柳露长叹一声。
“本座苦修两百余年，毕生所愿唯有得道飞升，如今我离得偿所愿只有一步之遥。”
“这些年来本座把你们当做亲姐妹，亲女儿一样看待。”
“如今是你们回报本座的时候了。”
柳露说完一挥手，无数的毒蛇从洞中的各处角落汇聚而来，将三人毫不费力的缠绕捆绑起来。
服下毒丹的三人发不出任何声音，就如同三座精美的雕塑一般，没有任何动作和反抗，呆呆站在那里。
“长卿，还记得书中记载的人彘是怎么做的么，本座同你这三位师姐师伯情谊深厚，下不去手。”
“你刚刚给她们都行了礼，磕了头，也算是提前赔礼了。”
说着，柳露转身从书架上拿出一把小刀，递给长卿。
“替本座把她们三个做成人彘吧。”
长卿接过小刀，走到风铃等人面前，对几人的脸仔细端详了片刻，却并没有动手。
“怎么，你下不去手？”
“师傅，我修为低微，二位师姐和师伯实力强大，我担心制作人彘的过程中，万一师姐师伯摆脱了控制......”

长卿犹豫道。
“你不必担心，她们服下的清心丹由本座精心炼制，不止可以让人全身僵化，动弹不得。更能封住人的窍穴，任凭再高的修为，也没法催动御灵。”
柳露之前还说着情谊深厚，下不去手之类的话，此时介绍起自己的毒丹又有些得意的意味。
“而且此丹还有提神醒脑的功效，可让她们时刻保持清醒，更清楚地感受痛苦，激发起她们心中的怨气。”
“同时还有凝血治伤，补充养分，激活生机的功效，保证她们性命无忧。”
柳露一边说着，一边拍了拍长卿的后背，鼓励道。
“乖徒儿，你和她们师出同门，你也最清楚本座想要什么，由你来动手最合适，交给别人，本座不放心啊。”
长卿却依旧没有动手，而是伸出一根手指，试了试小刀的锋芒。
手指轻轻按在刀锋上，瞬间被划开一道口子。
柳露皱了皱眉，不满道：“你这废物，还在犹豫什么，真当本座在和你商量么，动手！”
“师傅，您误会了，徒儿只是觉得这刀太锋利了，制作人彘的时候太痛快，只怕不能最大程度激发起她们的怨气。”
“还请师傅换一把钝刀给徒儿，再给徒儿一把锯子，一点一点锯掉她们的手脚，噢对了，还需要一根钢针，用来扎聋耳朵。”
长卿语气淡漠，声音平静。
柳露一愣，随后笑了起来，高兴地拍了拍长卿的肩膀。
她似乎心情极好，从随身携带的锦囊中取出一把药粉，享受地吸入体内。
content_en:
Changqing watched the three of them take the elixir and couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
"The way of heaven brings about reincarnation."
This elixir is a poisonous elixir that Chang Qing personally watched Liu Lu refine.
Moreover, when refining, Liu Lu used a dark purple imperial spirit. The imperial spirit exuded a terrifying aura. Liu Lu extracted a few drops of essence from it and put them all into the alchemy furnace.
The rose bone thorn spirit in Changqing's orifice is a low-grade yellow spirit, which is milky white. He had also seen Rose use the light blue Xuanling in his previous life.
The Yuling used by Liu Lu was dark purple. He was not sure what level of Yuling it was. It was either an earth spirit or a heavenly spirit.
The toxicity and power can be imagined.
Watching several people take the elixir, Liu Lu sighed.
"I have been practicing hard for more than two hundred years. My lifelong wish is to attain enlightenment and ascend to heaven. Now I am only one step away from getting my wish."
"Over the years, I have treated you as my own sisters and daughters."
"Now is the time for you to repay me."
After Liu Lu finished speaking, she waved her hand, and countless venomous snakes gathered from all corners of the cave, entangling and binding the three of them effortlessly.
The three people who took the poison pill could not make any sound. They were like three exquisite sculptures, standing there blankly without any movement or resistance.
"Chang Qing, do you still remember how the human pigs were made in the book? I have a deep friendship with your three senior sisters and uncles, and I can't do it."
"You just saluted and kowtowed to them all, which is considered an apology in advance."
With that said, Liu Lu turned around and took out a knife from the bookshelf and handed it to Chang Qing.
"Let me make the three of them into human pigs."
Changqing took the knife and walked to Feng Ling and others. He carefully studied their faces for a moment, but did not make a move.
"What, you can't do it?"
"Master, my cultivation level is low, but my two senior sisters and uncle are powerful. I am worried that in the process of making human pigs, if my senior sisters and uncle get out of control..."
Changqing hesitated.
"You don't have to worry. The Qingxin Pill they took was carefully refined by me. It can not only freeze people's bodies and make them unable to move. It can also seal people's acupoints. No matter how high their cultivation level is, they can't activate the Yuling."
Liu Lu had previously said that she had a deep friendship and couldn't do anything about it, but now she introduced her poison elixir with a hint of pride.
"Furthermore, this elixir also has the effect of refreshing the mind, allowing them to stay awake at all times, feel the pain more clearly, and arouse the resentment in their hearts."
"At the same time, it also has the functions of coagulating blood, healing injuries, replenishing nutrients, and activating vitality, ensuring that their lives are worry-free."
As Liu Lu spoke, she patted Changqing on the back and encouraged him.
"My good disciple, you are from the same school as them, and you know best what I want. It is best for you to take action. If you leave it to others, I won't trust you."
Chang Qing still did not take action, but stretched out a finger to test the edge of the knife.
He pressed his finger gently on the blade, and a cut was instantly made.
Liu Lu frowned and said dissatisfied: "You loser, what are you still hesitating about? Do you really think that I am discussing with you? Let's do it!"
"Master, you misunderstood. I just think this knife is too sharp and makes people eat it too happily. I'm afraid it won't arouse their resentment to the greatest extent."
"Please ask the master to give the disciple a dull knife and a saw to cut off their hands and feet bit by bit. Oh, by the way, we also need a steel needle to pierce the deaf ears."
Changqing's tone was indifferent and his voice was calm.
Liu Lu was stunned for a moment, then laughed and patted Chang Qing on the shoulder happily.
She seemed to be in a good mood. She took out a handful of medicinal powder from the bag she carried with her and inhaled it with enjoyment.
